atomic_task: Make paper-archetype-atlas the canonical taxonomy
rationale: Conflicting five-type and richer archetype systems can route the same paper differently
acceptance_criteria: One canonical ID set; legacy types map as coarse supertypes; all routers validate against it
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Hybrid resource+evaluation paper routes identically from academic-writing and pipeline

atomic_task: Add paper-, study-, and result-level archetype fields
rationale: One paper can contain heterogeneous studies and claim types
acceptance_criteria: State supports dominant/secondary paper archetype plus per-study and per-result type
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Multi-study paper with RCT and qualitative process evaluation

atomic_task: Create versioned project schema and stable object IDs
rationale: Chat-only state cannot be resumed or audited
acceptance_criteria: Schema validation, semantic version, migration hooks, stable IDs
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Round-trip load/save of project with no loss

atomic_task: Create JSONL ledgers for claims, sources, analyses, figures, concerns, and deviations
rationale: Prose ledgers are not deterministic or machine-checkable
acceptance_criteria: Every material object has ID, version, status, actor, timestamp, and links
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Fixture validates complete state and rejects dangling links

atomic_task: Add research-contract object
rationale: Argument spine lacks estimand, units, scope, comparator, and decision criteria
acceptance_criteria: Question, contribution, unit, population/domain, comparator, outcome/evidence criterion, estimand, hypotheses, boundaries, decisive evidence
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Association study with incompatible unit of inference is blocked

atomic_task: Add generic protocol schema and design adapters
rationale: No versioned plan links intended study to report
acceptance_criteria: Protocol versions are immutable; each plan item has status and downstream links
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Protocol amendment creates new version and relation

atomic_task: Add statistical/computational analysis-plan schema
rationale: Prespecified and exploratory analyses cannot be reliably distinguished
acceptance_criteria: Each analysis has question/estimand, population, variables, model/test, uncertainty, diagnostics, multiplicity, missingness, status
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Outcome-switch fixture is detected

atomic_task: Add deviation ledger and reconciliation gate
rationale: Post hoc changes can be laundered into final Methods
acceptance_criteria: Every deviation records date, actor, reason, affected objects, consequence, and disclosure location
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Changed primary outcome remains labeled deviation in Abstract/Results

atomic_task: Replace availability-only state with data-asset schema
rationale: Availability prose is not authoritative data governance
acceptance_criteria: Identity, owner, license, access, sensitivity, schema, unit, lineage, checksums, snapshots, defects, repository version
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Availability statement generated from data asset and fails on dead/mismatched version

atomic_task: Add data validation reports and transformation lineage
rationale: Silent cleaning and unit changes can alter claims
acceptance_criteria: Validation rules, failures, overrides, transformations, input/output hashes
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Unit mismatch and duplicate-participant fixtures fail

atomic_task: Create analysis object and execution receipt
rationale: Results/figures currently lack reproducible computational lineage
acceptance_criteria: Analysis links plan item, data snapshot, code, environment, seeds, diagnostics, exact outputs, receipt
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Clean rerun reproduces expected results within declared tolerance

atomic_task: Implement claim-source-analysis-figure graph
rationale: Independent ledgers do not prove end-to-end support
acceptance_criteria: No dangling support edges; edge type/status/version required; graph query finds upstream evidence and downstream surfaces
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Changing data snapshot invalidates dependent results/figures/claims

atomic_task: Unify metadata identity, locator, and entailment statuses
rationale: A correct reference can still fail to support a claim
acceptance_criteria: Separate identity_status, locator_status, entailment_status, source_version_status
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Correct DOI/wrong-support fixture is blocked

atomic_task: Add correction/retraction/preprint-version relations
rationale: Outdated or retracted sources may remain trusted
acceptance_criteria: Source record stores version relations and current integrity status; release gate lists affected claims
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Retracted-source mutation invalidates support edge

atomic_task: Replace binary readiness with assurance vector
rationale: Internal consistency, reproducibility, verification, and replication are distinct
acceptance_criteria: Release report exposes each dimension and never upgrades unverified dimensions
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: A1 manuscript cannot be labeled independently verified

atomic_task: Separate scientific assurance from target readiness
rationale: Journal transfer should not reopen verified science
acceptance_criteria: Target projection is independent object; switching venue changes mechanics only
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Transfer from Venue A to B preserves claim/data assurance

atomic_task: Resolve reporting/design standards by study and result type
rationale: One generic checklist cannot cover heterogeneous scholarship
acceptance_criteria: Resolver returns applicable adapters, versions, required items, N/A rationale, source review date
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Hybrid paper composes two adapters without conflict

atomic_task: Create machine-readable contract schema
rationale: Rich prose guidance produces inconsistent decisions
acceptance_criteria: Reader question, required inputs, allowed claims, forbidden moves, traceability, reporting hooks, invariants, exit tests
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Missing denominator deterministically fails Results contract

atomic_task: Add contracts for missing front/back matter
rationale: Keywords, declarations, availability, accessibility, and supplements are not first-class
acceptance_criteria: Contracts exist for title through post-publication metadata and are adapter-aware
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Submission fixture fails when AI-use or data availability state is unresolved

atomic_task: Enforce Methods↔Results bidirectional links
rationale: Orphan methods, outcome switching, and HARKing are hard to detect
acceptance_criteria: Every consequential method has a downstream status; every result links plan/method/data/analysis
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Orphan method and unplanned result fixtures fail

atomic_task: Link every figure/table to an analysis and data snapshot
rationale: Visual evidence can drift from reported results
acceptance_criteria: Figure spec includes claim, analysis, data, render receipt, source data, alt text, long description
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Old-snapshot figure mutation fails consistency gate

atomic_task: Expand nature-statistics into analysis-and-inference
rationale: Reporting checks cannot repair design/analysis mismatch
acceptance_criteria: Core interfaces for estimand, assumptions, missingness, multiplicity, diagnostics, sensitivity, dependence
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Pseudoreplication and non-significance-as-equivalence fixtures fail

atomic_task: Separate discovery recommendation from manuscript evidence search
rationale: Daily ranking and journal-quality weights can bias evidence selection
acceptance_criteria: Recommender outputs marked discovery-only; manuscript modes log search, screening, coverage, stopping
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Top-5 digest cannot be labeled systematic evidence base

atomic_task: Move PPT/patent/download utilities outside implicit scientific routing
rationale: Downstream tools obscure canonical scientific responsibilities
acceptance_criteria: Utilities are explicit-only and consume validated project objects
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Academic-writing invocation never loads PPT/patent utilities

atomic_task: Add confidentiality and permitted-AI-processing state
rationale: Unpublished manuscripts/data may be exposed to unapproved services
acceptance_criteria: Confidentiality label and processing policy are mandatory before external tools; violations block
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Confidential review packet cannot be sent to unapproved AI

atomic_task: Add AI-use disclosure and human accountability record
rationale: Current policies require explicit human responsibility and often disclosure
acceptance_criteria: Tool, purpose, inputs, confidentiality, human checks, output role, target policy, disclosure location
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: AI-generated draft with missing disclosure fails target gate

atomic_task: Build behavioral fixture harness
rationale: Phrase assertions do not test scientific behavior
acceptance_criteria: Fixture runner compares claims, links, blockers, assurance, release; deterministic schema errors
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: At least 20 P0 red/green fixtures

atomic_task: Add mutation and adversarial tests
rationale: Small qualifier/denominator/version changes cause high-risk failures
acceptance_criteria: Mutations cover causal verbs, qualifiers, denominators, source versions, hashes, prespecification
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Each mutation changes expected state and is caught

atomic_task: Freeze and hash independent review packets
rationale: Reviewer independence is currently instructional
acceptance_criteria: Packet hash, allowed context, competence/conflict profile, no editor conclusion in reviewer packet
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Leakage test detects editor-decision text in reviewer input

atomic_task: Add power/precision/information-adequacy adapters
rationale: Adequacy criteria vary by design
acceptance_criteria: Adapters for trials, observational, prediction, qualitative, corpus, theory/resource
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Retrospective power justification flagged where inappropriate

atomic_task: Add estimand and target-trial adapter
rationale: Causal claims require explicit target and assumptions
acceptance_criteria: Time zero, strategies, assignment, outcome, estimand, confounders, identification, sensitivity
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Immortal-time and target-population mismatch fixtures fail

atomic_task: Add leakage/calibration/fairness/external-testing adapter
rationale: Accuracy-only benchmark reporting is insufficient
acceptance_criteria: Split provenance, tuning boundary, calibration, subgroup/fairness, external testing, utility, compute
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Patient leakage and internal-as-external fixtures fail

atomic_task: Add systematic-review risk-of-bias and certainty objects
rationale: Search alone does not establish synthesis credibility
acceptance_criteria: Screening, extraction, RoB per result, synthesis, heterogeneity, certainty, update date
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Selective pooling and missing risk-of-bias fixtures fail

atomic_task: Add reflexivity, coding, saturation, and audit-trail adapter
rationale: Quantitative contracts cannot substitute for qualitative rigor
acceptance_criteria: Researcher position, sampling rationale, codebook, coder roles, adjudication, negative cases, information adequacy
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Unsupported saturation and missing quote provenance fail

atomic_task: Add contributor confirmation and CRediT-compatible roles
rationale: Contribution should be agreed and machine-readable but not decide authorship
acceptance_criteria: Role assignments confirmed; authorship criteria handled separately; contributor changes versioned
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Unconfirmed role and ghost contributor fixture fail

atomic_task: Add funding, funder role, and conflict ledger
rationale: Funding/COI can affect interpretation and submission
acceptance_criteria: Awards, support, funder role, financial/nonfinancial conflicts, management, confirmations
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Funder analysis role omitted in manuscript fails consistency

atomic_task: Add figure/table/media accessibility validator
rationale: Accessibility is part of scholarly communication and reuse
acceptance_criteria: Alt text, long descriptions, semantic headers, transcripts, meaningful links
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Missing alt text and duplicate-caption alt text fixtures fail

atomic_task: Export RO-Crate/DataCite-aligned release metadata
rationale: Project bundle needs portable provenance and persistent relations
acceptance_criteria: Valid crate metadata; versions/relations/licenses/creators/funders represented
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Schema validation of example release crate

atomic_task: Add semantic diff and claim-strength regression
rationale: Polishing/revision can silently change scientific meaning
acceptance_criteria: Diff tracks claims, numbers, qualifiers, citations, identifiers; changed items reverified
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Replace associated with caused mutation is blocked

atomic_task: Add correction/update/withdrawal workflow
rationale: Research state should not end at submission
acceptance_criteria: New versions link to old; affected claims/artifacts identified; notices preserved
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Correction to one analysis propagates to figures/claims

atomic_task: Merge polishing into academic-writing modes
rationale: Duplicate routers create drift
acceptance_criteria: Single authoritative contracts; compatibility entry point delegates without duplication
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Same revision produces same state through both entry points

atomic_task: Migrate proposal state into research contract
rationale: Proposal and paper lifecycles should preserve lineage
acceptance_criteria: Proposal objects become upstream project/protocol versions; arbitrary score gates removed
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Proposal-to-paper fixture preserves question and deviations

atomic_task: Freeze nature-writing as support-only facade
rationale: Legacy duplicate authority increases maintenance cost
acceptance_criteria: Facade delegates; authoritative assets moved to neutral paths; deprecation tests
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: No implicit invocation; migration warnings and docs

atomic_task: Generate documentation from schemas and adapters
rationale: Hand-copied policy prose drifts
acceptance_criteria: Reference docs, field tables, examples, and manifests generated from versioned sources
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: CI detects generated-doc drift

atomic_task: Add reviewed date/source/version to policy snapshots
rationale: Current guidance changes over time
acceptance_criteria: Every external adapter records authority, version/date, reviewed date, unresolved conflicts
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Stale policy warning after configured interval

atomic_task: Add English/Chinese semantic parity tests
rationale: Bilingual mirrors can diverge scientifically
acceptance_criteria: Key invariants and examples map across languages; translation cannot alter claim strength
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Mutation in one language mirror fails CI

atomic_task: Create versioned benchmark corpus and adjudication protocol
rationale: Long-term quality needs stable measurement
acceptance_criteria: Licensing, confidentiality, gold labels, ambiguity policy, adjudicator roles, versioning documented
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Benchmark release validates and reproduces baseline metrics

atomic_task: Load contracts by dependency graph rather than giant manifests
rationale: Large prose context increases cost and inconsistency
acceptance_criteria: Minimal required invariants always load; adapters/sections load on demand; dependency tests
adversarial_or_behavioral_test: Task loads no unrelated PPT/patent/section assets
